name: Paraswap
fix_description: In uniswapV3SwapCallback, the multi-hop path (data.length > 160) does not validate that msg.sender is a legitimate Uniswap V3 pool before reading payer from calldata. Add pool address verification (CREATE2 check) in all code paths, not just the single-hop else branch.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a clear multi-step price-manipulation attack using a flash loan, Pancake V3 swaps, and repeated interaction with a protocol-specific vulnerable swap contract. It is not deeply complex, but writing the PoC requires understanding the contract’s special approved-address logic and sequencing the price distortion correctly across several external calls.
